newsitem.title: UK: UK ASA names Lustig-Prean deputy director general.
newsitem.headline: UK ASA names Lustig-Prean deputy director general.

text.p: Britain's Advertising Standards Authority said on Wednesday it had named Duncan Lustig-Prean as deputy director general.

Lustig-Prean has been chairman of Rank Outsiders, a career guidance and counseling service for those leaving the armed forces. He succeeds Christopher Odgen as deputy director general of the ASA, the industry self-regulating body for non-broadcast advertisements in the UK.
